description:
The attached S22 gave us a closer look at stock Messenger 580. Its inbox already has a Hide suggestions action, and Photos & media has an external-browser switch. We also checked notification categories, chat heads and the in-app Accessibility page. The roadmap now calls for testing these controls before adding patches that might duplicate them.

The patch itself is unchanged. Two clean local builds produced the same bundle checksum, and all 12 tests passed. Morphe Desktop patched and signed a private copy of the S22 APK off-device. Android verified its APK v3 signature. A changed APK failed before an output was written.

Patched Messenger has not been installed on either phone. The S22 and S25 still have their stock apps and local data.

## Files

- [Patch bundle](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/releases/download/v0.0.7/patches-0.0.7.mpp)
- [SHA-256 checksum](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/releases/download/v0.0.7/SHA256SUMS.txt)

This is a preview patch source. You supply the stock Messenger APK. Read the [setup and data warning](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger#readme) before patching.
